pivot_rationale: Test collapsing Space Tower's two visual modes (3D exterior + 2D side-on sim) into a single isometric view as the baseline. This slice exists in a separate repo from the existing game so the iso experiment can be archived if it does not feel right, with no impact on shipping work.

target.scope: one floor, controllable character, pannable/zoomable/rotatable iso camera

garden_visual_signature.summary: Stacked planters with crops ripening, translucent water pipes with visibly flowing water, warm grow-light glow.
elements: Stacked planters with tomatoes and fruit ripening on the planters
Translucent water pipes with flowing water visible through/beneath the planter boxes
Warm grow-light glow over the planters; emissive amber light
Color palette: warm greens (plants), translucent blues (water), amber/gold (grow lights). No cold greys.
animation: Grow lights pulse on a 2–3s cycle

design_principles_that_must_survive: The player's body is the tool — walking on the iso floor must feel like a person, not a cursor.
Discovery over instruction — no tutorials. If a control is unclear, redesign it.
Character dignity — even programmatic placeholder characters should read as people.
Fixed block identities with direct causal consequences — each planter / pipe / light is a thing, not abstract decoration.
Exterior/interior unification via iso — the iso view replaces the old split between 3D exterior and 2D sim.
RGB boundary is sacred — the sim is handcrafted; only the RGB is procedurally alive (not in scope here, but do not erode the boundary).

constants_canonical_for_iso.notes: BLOCK_WIDTH and FLOOR_HEIGHT carried forward from sibling space-tower/autoloads/constants.gd. ISO_TILE_W/H are placeholders; refined after Phase 1 research.

the_reckoning_one_paragraph: Floor 8 is the conflict floor. When Floor 8 reaches buildout stage 5 and all floors are stage ≥ 1, The Reckoning triggers: a 90-second mini-game where 12 builder AI vs. 18 suit AI in squads fight for block territory on floors 6–8. The player claims blocks by standing on them. Post-reckoning, 30 civilian NPCs flood in. The player's color choice (builder faction) persists. Out of scope here, but Phase 4 self-evaluation must speculate on how this would look in an iso view.
